utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with setup and make sure we’ve got the supplies covered—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules — setup and supplies sound great. I’m ready with the tools, so just tell me what needs doing next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Leo. Let’s keep it simple: you handle the practical bits, and I’ll keep the word moving about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll handle the practical bits and bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ll make sure everyone gets the updated Sunday time and community center location.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — you’ll send the updated Sunday time and community center location to everyone, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just the basics to help me pitch in — what needs doing, where should I show up, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Folks around here usually pitch in when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep tracking the location and let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive, just keeping it low-key for now. I’ll send along the final date, time, and repair list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — that works. Keep me posted, and I’ll handle the practical bits on my end.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still on it—I’m a bit swamped, but I’ll check the details and get you the date, time, and repair list soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great—if there’s a first batch ready, I can swing by and pick it up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll send you the first batch details, and if you can pick it up, that really helps keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still tracking the supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what you need, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Cleo — I just need the final list and timing from Eli before I pass it along to everyone. Once that’s set, I’ll help keep the neighborhood in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, we’re still on for this afternoon. Could you help spread the word and line up anyone who wants to volunteer?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once Eli locks it in, please send me the date, time, and repair list so I can plan around it. Then I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the date, time, and repair list as soon as I hear them. Happy to help spread the word once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—has anything changed yet, or do you still need supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I still need the updated list and timing. Send me the details and I’ll help out.
